lines.label: Change
lines.note: ARAM: Mayhem is going live with this patch. ARAM Mayhem is just like the usual 5v5 single lane goodness but at the start of each match, you'll get to choose one of three augments to kick off your build, with another choice at levels 7, 11, and 15. Just like items, you can claim them on death! (Or if you're a "cheater" you might find an augment that allows you to back to base to shop and claim augments).
